parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "version": "1.0",
  "event_id": "evt_qa_" + $json.job_id + "_" + Date.now(),
  "job_id": $json.job_id,
  "event": "qa.validated",
  "status": "COMPLETED",
  "stage": "RENDER_READY",
  "progress": 100,
  "message": "تم فحص واعتماد جودة الفيديو النهائي MP4 ومطابقة الأبعاد والخط الصوتي بنجاح"
}

={
  "version": "1.0",
  "event_id": "evt_render_final_" + $json.render_id + "_" + Date.now(),
  "job_id": $json.job_id,
  "video_id": $json.video_id,
  "render_id": $json.render_id,
  "status": "READY",
  "stage": "RENDER_READY",
  "progress": 100,
  "message": "الفيديو النهائي متاح للمشاهدة والتحميل بأعلى جودة",
  "render_output": {
    "storageProvider": "r2",
    "bucket": "video-factory-media",
    "objectKey": $json.objectKey,
    "mimeType": "video/mp4",
    "sizeBytes": $json.sizeBytes,
    "durationSeconds": $json.durationSeconds,
    "width": $json.width,
    "height": $json.height,
    "fps": 30,
    "checksum": $json.checksum
  }
}
